verdict.rationale: Omnara's pricing page says it is 'Free to self-host and build on. Open source under Apache 2.0,' and the GitHub repo refers to 'self-hosted deployments' that can query agent history directly in Postgres. Together these show the core product is open source and meant to be self-hosted. Missing for 10: a documented self-hosting or deployment guide (requirements, setup steps, which components are included), and independent or hands-on confirmation that someone has actually self-hosted it.
